settingsTaskConfig.title: Task configuration

noWorkspace.title: No Workspace
noWorkspace.description: Create a workspace first to configure task settings.

statuses.heading: Task Statuses
statuses.subtitle: Define the workflow statuses for tasks. Drag to reorder.
statuses.emptyDescription: Create your first status to define your task workflow.
statuses.forkTitle: This project uses the workspace defaults
statuses.forkDescription: Customizing here will fork the workspace statuses into a project-scoped copy. Other projects keep using the workspace defaults.

categories.heading: Status Categories
categories.subtitle: Buckets that statuses belong to. Each carries a semantics flag (Open / Active / Done / Cancelled) used for burndown and velocity.
categories.inherited: These categories are inherited from the workspace. Adding one copies the full set into this project first, so nothing here disappears — after that the project keeps its own buckets and workspace changes no longer reach it. To rename or recolor a shared bucket for every project, switch the scope above to Workspace defaults.
categories.empty: No categories yet — they'll seed automatically when you save your first status.
categories.inUse: Can't delete "{label}" — statuses still use it. Reassign them first.
categories.inUseServer: This category is still in use by one or more statuses.

fields.heading: Custom Fields

fields.emptyDescription: Create custom fields to add extra metadata to your tasks.
fields.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this field? Field data will be removed from all tasks.
